provenance.meaning: a revoked / rotated App private key: GitHub cannot verify the JWT
provenance.method: curl with an RS256 App JWT signed by a throwaway 2048-bit key generated for the probe (registered to no App); status, headers and body recorded verbatim
provenance.request: POST /app/installations/1/access_tokens, JWT iss=15368 (an existing App) signed with a key that App does not hold
provenance.sanitization: none needed: the reply carries no credential

response.body: {"message":"A JSON web token could not be decoded","documentation_url":"https://docs.github.com/rest","status":"401"}
